pages.title: Geodesic Thread
pages.text: The straightest line possible in curved spacetime: the path a falling object takes. Around a black hole, geodesics curve, spiral and close in. The thread bends according to the gravity around it and never kinks.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a black hole, a geodesic is the only safe path. Following one with neutronium and the real continuum in the Chrono Loom, I wove relativity breakdown into a thread that always falls straight.

Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Geodesic Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Tessellate.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Christoffel Symbol, Differential Manifold, Hyperbolic Stone, Unified Notes I.
